rationale: Replace imitation of a small-sample teacher with training-only depth neighbourhood constraints; preserve ordinal score differences by regularising residual differences instead of smoothing scores toward equality.
encoder: Fully frozen ImageNet ResNet18, independent RGB and normalised-depth encodings, episode means, L2 normalisation
graph: Training nodes only; no edges within the same animal group; up to five nearest different-group nodes with absolute BCS difference <=1; Gaussian distance weights; symmetrise with maximum; unnormalised Laplacian rescaled to trace=n.
training_risk: Episode weights inversely proportional to training episode count per animal group, rescaled to mean one; unweighted KRR and SVR also reported
objective: (K a - yc)^T S (K a-yc) + alpha a^T K a + gamma (K a-yc)^T L_depth (K a-yc); yc centered by the group-balanced training mean
selection: Lowest inner-validation MAE, fixed grid ordering breaks exact ties; outer test used only after each arm is selected
mismatch: Reassign training depth features from a different animal within native-depth-width-majority strata with replacement, deterministic seed; preserve ordinal label gate and save all mappings
scope: An application-specific candidate built on established manifold and privileged-information learning, not a claim to invent graph regularisation. Subsequent results remain exploratory.
